name: superbee
description: Agent-facing Superbee CLI for reading and writing local OKF knowledge bundles: context notes, docs, cross-links, and live bundle Views.

scripts.test: node build.mjs local-dev && ASLITE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 AGENTSTATE_LITE_NO_AUTOPULL=1 GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=test-suite GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=test-suite@example.invalid GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=test-suite GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=test-suite@example.invalid node --test --import ./test/ts-loader.mjs ./test/*.test.ts
scripts.mutation: ASLITE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 AGENTSTATE_LITE_NO_AUTOPULL=1 GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=test-suite GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=test-suite@example.invalid GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=test-suite GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=test-suite@example.invalid stryker run
